class.name: AcousticHearing3D
class.brief_description: Ears for an enemy, or anything else that reacts to sound, from the Asosdot Acoustic Engine.

method.name: listens_to
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param event] is a sound these ears listen for at all, before how loud it is: one of [member sound_types], and not their own unless [member hears_own_sounds] is on.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], sounds whose [member AcousticEvent.source] is these ears or a node they are inside, such as the enemy's own footsteps, aren't heard.
The least loudness heard, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Quieter sounds aren't heard at all.
How keen these ears are: how far a sound carries for them is multiplied by this. [code]2.0[/code] hears the same sound from twice as far away.
The kinds of sound these ears listen for, matched against [member AcousticEvent.sound_type]. Empty listens for every kind.

signal.name: sound_heard
signal.description: Emitted when a sound reaches these ears. [param loudness] is how loud it is here, from [code]1.0[/code] right next to it to [code]0.0[/code] at the edge of how far it carries. [param from_position] is where it seems to come from: where it was made when it came straight, or the last opening it came round through, which is the place to go and look.
